exclusions_of_note.name: Conditional Follow Form — 'more restrictive' clause
exclusions_of_note.impact: Per Section I: 'If any Underlying Policy includes any more restrictive coverage, terms, definitions, exclusions, conditions, or limitations, then this policy will follow the more restrictive provisions of any Underlying Policy.' This is the standard conditional follow form trap — every exclusion or carve-out on the underlying Gemini Tech E&O flows up. If Gemini has, e.g., an election technology carve-out, BIPA carve-out, or contractual liability limitation, those flow up to this excess layer too.

exclusions_of_note.name: Sublimits in underlying do NOT extend to this policy
exclusions_of_note.impact: Section II: 'If any Underlying Policy grants coverage subject to a sublimit of liability, this policy shall not afford such coverage, however this policy shall recognize any reduction or exhaustion of the Attachment Point by payments with respect to such coverage pursuant to that Underlying Policy.' Translation: any sublimited coverage on Gemini (e.g., regulatory defense sublimit, breach response sublimit, BIPA sublimit) is NOT extended by this excess policy — but those sublimit payments DO erode the $5M attachment. Net effect: client pays for sublimited coverage twice (no excess) but still depletes the attachment.

exclusions_of_note.name: Maintenance of Underlying Insurance
exclusions_of_note.impact: If insured fails to maintain underlying or renews/replaces with lesser coverage, Convex is liable only as if the underlying had been fully maintained. Failure to maintain does NOT void the policy but the excess attaches as if the underlying limit were intact — the insured eats the gap. Contrast with the 'maintenance violation = no coverage' trap on some umbrellas.

exclusions_of_note.name: Unimpaired Underlying Limits warranty
exclusions_of_note.impact: Insured warrants total underlying limits unimpaired at inception. If impaired, this policy applies as if unimpaired (insured eats the gap). For non-concurrent periods, only claims covered during this policy's period count toward exhaustion of underlying aggregates — insured retains liability for resulting gaps.

exclusions_of_note.name: Sanction Limitation and Exclusion (OFAC)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard sanctions exclusion — no payment if it would expose Convex to UN/EU/UK/US sanctions. Low concern for domestic election services unless international expansion.

exclusions_of_note.name: Surplus Lines / Non-Admitted Carrier — AZ Guaranty Fund Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Convex Insurance UK Limited is non-admitted in AZ. Per A.R.S. §20-401.01(B)(1), if Convex becomes insolvent, no AZ Property and Casualty Guaranty Fund protection applies. Informational note — surplus lines is the appropriate market for this layer; carrier is part of the Convex Group (Bermuda parent, UK FCA/PRA regulated). Verify AM Best rating against Sacramento County A-VII / Maricopa County B++ minimums.

sacramento_county_satisfaction.applies_to_e_and_o_minimum: Sacramento §III.E requires $1M/$1M Professional Liability. Gemini primary $5M alone exceeds the minimum; this Convex excess provides additional $5M for total $10M Tech E&O tower — strongly exceeds the $1M minimum.
sacramento_county_satisfaction.umbrella_may_satisfy_e_and_o: Sacramento §II.E EXPRESSLY EXCLUDES Professional Liability from coverages umbrella may follow form over. However, this is NOT a commercial umbrella — it is a dedicated Excess Professional Liability policy specifically designed to sit over the primary E&O. Convex excess is therefore a permissible vehicle for stacking on the E&O tower.
sacramento_county_satisfaction.retro_date_compliance: Sacramento §V.A requires retro 'on or before the date of the Agreement or beginning of Agreement performance.' Convex retro 03/27/2017 matches Gemini primary — verify this predates each Sacramento contract effective date.
sacramento_county_satisfaction.erp_compliance: Sacramento §V.C requires minimum 1-year ERP. ERP availability follows form to Gemini — verify on primary.

maricopa_county_satisfaction.applies_to_e_and_o: Maricopa §8.2.3 requires retro before contract effective + 2-year ERP for any claims-made line. Convex retro 03/27/2017 is well before any 2024-2026 Maricopa contract. ERP follows form to Gemini — verify primary policy provides 2 years.
maricopa_county_satisfaction.carrier_rating_compliance: Maricopa §8.2.1 requires AM Best B++. Convex Insurance UK Limited — verify AM Best rating; UK PRA/FCA-regulated subsidiary of Convex Re (Bermuda). Need to confirm AM Best rating meets B++ (and Sacramento A-VII).
maricopa_county_satisfaction.no_e_and_o_specific_minimum: Maricopa §8.2 does not specify a Professional Liability minimum limit; only Cyber ($5M) is specified. The $10M Tech E&O tower comfortably exceeds any unwritten expectation.

key_observations: FOLLOW-FORM EXCESS ONLY — this policy provides $5M xs $5M of Professional Liability over Gemini primary Tech E&O. It is NOT a commercial umbrella and does NOT excess GL, Auto, EL, or Cyber. The Tech E&O tower is now $10M total.

RETRO DATE SOLID — 03/27/2017 retro on Convex matches Gemini primary. No retro gap at the excess layer. For an election technology company that has been in business 50+ years and serves 90M+ voters, this 2017 retro likely covers the contracts in this audit (Sacramento, Maricopa, LA County).

POLICY NUMBER DISCREPANCY — Dec page Item 5 shows Gemini policy VIPL056495; Schedule of Underlying Insurance (XPL-301, page 13) shows VIPL055885. Both Gemini, but the policy number doesn't match. Flag for housekeeping correction with the carrier — minor administrative defect, not coverage-threatening.

CONDITIONAL FOLLOW FORM TRAP — Section I states this policy follows 'the more restrictive' of the underlying when there's a conflict. Any restrictive endorsement on Gemini primary (e.g., a restrictive election-services definition, BIPA exclusion, contractual liability carve-back) flows up to and limits this excess. Audit Gemini primary for restrictive endorsements; the restrictions there ARE the restrictions here.

SUBLIMITED COVERAGES NOT EXTENDED — Section II expressly states: any sublimited coverage on Gemini is NOT afforded by this excess. So if Gemini has, say, a $250K regulatory defense sublimit, the Convex excess will NOT add a second $250K — it will only attach over the FULL $5M attachment, but those sublimited dollars on Gemini still erode the attachment. This is standard for follow-form excess but worth flagging for CFO.

SURPLUS LINES / NON-ADMITTED IN AZ — Convex UK Ltd is non-admitted; AZ Guaranty Fund does not apply. Informational only. The excess tech E&O tower is appropriately placed in the surplus lines market — admitted carriers rarely write $5M xs $5M tech E&O for election technology firms.

NO ADDITIONAL INSURED / NO WAIVER OF SUBROGATION / NO P&NC — these are not applicable to a follow-form excess Professional Liability policy (and contracts uniformly carve E&O out of AI/WoS requirements). Sacramento §II.E and Maricopa §8.2.7-§8.2.8 both expressly exclude E&O from AI requirement. Compliant.

MAINTENANCE OF UNDERLYING — Section IV.D is favorable: failure to maintain does NOT void the policy; instead, Convex acts as if underlying were intact (insured eats the gap). This is the better of the two common maintenance constructions per the KB Book of Solutions Umbrella material.
DUTY TO DEFEND ON DROP-DOWN — Section IV.B.2 grants right AND duty to defend once underlying exhausts. Strong provision.
